fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) fell 4.4% on November 18 due to a Zacks Research downgrade and has recorded five consecutive trading days of decline.
fields.summary_ko.1: Zacks' target price of $1,881 implies approximately 150% upside from the current price of $762, but SemiAnalysis expects AI chip capital expenditure to decline by 19%, 28%, and 41% in 2027–2029 respectively.
